reason: The README describes an agent bridge for Cheat Engine focused on dynamic debugging, memory scanning, breakpoint analysis, and modifying single-player game process memory; the write and script capabilities warrant human review.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH Agent 连接到 Cheat Engine，用于单机进程的动态调试、内存扫描、指针分析、断点操作及受控内存修改。
summaries.en: Connects DSH Agent to Cheat Engine for single-player process debugging, memory scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoint operations, and controlled memory modification.

capabilities: Connects to a local Cheat Engine bridge
Scans, reads, and writes target process memory
Performs pointer analysis, disassembly, breakpoint, and register operations
Can lock memory addresses and execute debugging-related scripts
Provides session auditing, snapshots, and risk classification
